info.name: Indoor Management System API (Multi-Tenant)
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for testing the Indoor Sports Management & Booking Multi-Tenant SaaS platform.

Database: Multi-tenant MySQL 8.0 + Sequelize ORM
Tenant Isolation: Handled via the subdomain or the X-Tenant-Slug header in local dev.

Usage:
1. Super Admin Panel: Authenticate using 'Super Admin Login' -> JWT token automatically saved to {{superAdminToken}}.
2. Tenant Admin: Authenticate using 'Admin Login' -> JWT token automatically saved to {{adminToken}}.
3. Customer/User: Authenticate using OTP verification -> JWT token automatically saved to {{userToken}}.
4. Headers: All tenant-scoped requests automatically include 'X-Tenant-Slug: {{tenantSlug}}'. Customize {{tenantSlug}} to target different client databases.

request.description: Authenticate as the master superadmin. The token is saved to {{superAdminToken}} to authorize master operations.
Get a list of all client tenant databases, subdomains, and status.
Provision a new client tenant. This creates their database, compiles custom tables, seeds default settings/slots, and returns credentials.
Fetch detailed credentials and SMS configuration for a single tenant client.
Modify tenant properties, toggle status, change expiry date, or configure SMS credentials.
Permanently delete a tenant, drops their database container, and removes all mapping entries.
Authenticate as a tenant administrator. The JWT token is tenant-scoped and automatically saved to {{adminToken}}.
Retrieve the currently authenticated tenant admin profile.
Retrieve all staff manager accounts and active granular permissions (Primary Business Owner only).

request.description: Update manager details or feature permission object (Primary Business Owner only).
Delete a staff manager account (Primary Business Owner only).
Triggers SMS OTP verification code. In local dev mode, the generated OTP code is returned directly in the response payload for testing convenience.
Verifies the 6-digit OTP code and logs the user in. Generates a tenant-scoped customer user session JWT token.
Retrieves the customer user's profile details.
Updates customer information such as full name and email.
Fetch a list of all current and historical bookings associated with this customer phone number.
Submit a public booking reservation. Price is auto-calculated from settings. Status defaults to 'Pending'.
Dashboard overview — total bookings, revenue, peak slots, and occupancy rates.
List all bookings with optional filters (status, sport, search, date range).
Book a slot manually for a walk-in guest. Auto-confirmed by admin.
Fetch full details of a specific booking by its integer ID.
Update customer details on a booking. Uses optimistic locking (version column).
Change booking status: Pending → Confirmed → Completed or Cancelled. Creates a BookingStatusHistory record.
Soft-delete a booking (paranoid mode — recoverable via database).
Fetch all configured grounds/arenas sorted by display order priority.
Provision a new ground/arena for slot assignment.
Update ground properties such as name, sport, description or status.
Reorder grounds display sequence.
Deprovision an arena if no active bookings exist.
Submit a rescheduling request. Status transitions to pending and real-time dashboard notifications are pushed to the admin.
Submit a cancellation request for approval.
List all booking change or cancellation requests for administration review.
Approve or reject a cancellation or rescheduling request. If approved, the underlying booking database updates are automatically applied.
Query available time slots for a specific date. Resolves through: 1) specific date overrides, 2) weekday overrides, 3) default slots.
Fetch all master schedule slot configurations.
Add a new slot. dayOfWeek: -1 (all days default), 0-6 (Sun-Sat), or use specificDate for a one-off override.
Toggle slot active/inactive or modify time parameters.
Permanently remove a slot from the schedule.
Public-facing settings — business name, pricing, hero config, social links, etc.
Full admin settings including holidays, maintenance days, rules, dark mode toggle, etc.

request.description: Update business info, pricing tiers, hero config, and dark mode. Uses optimistic locking.
Retrieve all gallery images and 360° panorama items.
Upload a new image to the gallery. Saved to Cloudinary (or base64 fallback in dev mode).
Save custom display order of gallery items using integer IDs.
Remove an image from the gallery and delete its Cloudinary file.
Fetch approved reviews displayed on the homepage testimonials section.
Submit a public review. Saved as isApproved: false (pending admin moderation).
Fetch all reviews (approved + pending) for admin moderation.
Approve and optionally feature a customer review on the homepage.
Soft-delete a review (paranoid mode).
Submit a contact form message. Rate limited to 20 requests/hour.
Fetch all contact form submissions with read/reply status.
Toggle message read status.
Permanently delete a contact message.
Submit a rescheduling change request for an active booking. Supports target ground selection and exact slot count validation.
Submit a cancellation request for an active booking.
List all pending and processed customer reschedule/cancel requests.
Approve or reject a customer change/cancel request. Approved requests perform transaction-safe booking updates.
Fetch all investment and expense category classifications.
Create a new investment or expense category.
List filterable financial records (by type, category, date range, groundId, search query).
Log an investment or expense transaction with optional groundId scope.
Fetch financial aggregate metrics: total booking revenue, total investments, total expenses, net balance, and operating profit.
Server health check — verifies MySQL database connectivity, uptime, and API version.
